## TASK-020 - Integrate immutable Task memory packets

Implement a bounded packet builder that selects eligible prior accepted records, note/evidence digests, limits and explicit empty results. Stage in the manager-granted write scope, register through artifact.register, and bind the returned path/hash to baseline.inputs and assignment context.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-002, REQ-008, REQ-020, REQ-025, REQ-031, REQ-035, REQ-037 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/memory/scripts/memory_packet.py, SKILLS-depo/memory/references/task-integration.md, SKILLS-depo/agent-task/references/orchestration-contract.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-013, TASK-019 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- The Task helper does not infer that a context ref is memory; the memory integration must enforce packet sameness explicitly.

### Acceptance criteria

- Packet and referenced evidence conform to existing project-relative {path, sha256} refs, safe regular files, the 250000-byte per-file bound and the 200-entry evidence-list bound.
- The same immutable packet and canonical baseline reach every initial solver, including queued solvers, without a new Task schema field/event.

### Planned verification

- Register packets using the real helper in disposable Tasks with actual producer/write-scope restrictions.
- Test explicit empty packets, wrong digests, unsafe paths and packet-size limits; inspect baseline/context bindings.

## TASK-021 - Enforce frozen recall and sibling exclusions

Constrain additional solver memory lookup to the frozen packet plus assignment-permitted evidence. Exclude current sibling candidates, reviews, synthesis and proposals from direct/indexed/indirect sources and validate inherited context before dispatch.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-013, REQ-019, REQ-021, REQ-031, REQ-032, REQ-033, REQ-038 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/memory/scripts/memory_packet.py, SKILLS-depo/memory/references/task-integration.md, SKILLS-depo/task/references/memory-context.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-020 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Filesystem filtering alone cannot prove inherited-context isolation; actual native checks remain mandatory in PHASE-009.

### Acceptance criteria

- Publishing or editing another note cannot silently change one solver input; every permitted extra source is attributable to the assignment version.
- Contaminated full-history forks are rejected or replaced through an observed supported isolation route, never by an instruction to ignore drafts.

### Planned verification

- Plant sibling content in direct paths, permitted-corpus copies and backend projections and verify exclusion.
- Exercise queued initial-solver context construction and changed-note cases against the frozen digest set.

## TASK-022 - Integrate memory changes and publication receipts

Document and implement memory-side materiality checks and Task evidence linkage using existing subtask.revise, reconciliation, same-ID assignment.inputs and normal response references. Keep required memory deliverables separate from optional capture failures.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-003, REQ-008, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-033, REQ-034, REQ-035, REQ-037, REQ-039 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/memory/scripts/memory_packet.py, SKILLS-depo/memory/references/task-integration.md, SKILLS-depo/agent-task/references/task-system-contract.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-011, TASK-020, TASK-021 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- A memory receipt and Task event have separate commit boundaries; record both actual outcomes instead of claiming cross-system atomicity.

### Acceptance criteria

- Material memory changes invalidate affected current gates and reconcile running writers before rebinding; immaterial edits have an explicit assessment.
- Actual memory receipts can be linked through permitted Task artifacts/files without invented state, replayed events, terminal reopen or automatic task selection.

### Planned verification

- Run helper-backed version/generation/input tests and required-versus-optional memory failure cases.
- Verify stopped/completed observation, actual same-ID message, assignment.inputs then follow-up ordering for a changed packet.
